description: Score-based multi-assignment with fixed resource quotas:
- Assignment (default): Order tasks by best score + regret (best minus second-best score);
greedily assign each to its highest-scoring resource with available slots.
- Local Search: Optionally evaluate pairwise task swaps across resources; accept moves
- Termination: Stop on zero improvement, time limit, iteration limit, or minimum-gain
Java accepts finite float scores greater than -Float.MAX_VALUE and returns a stop category; elapsed-time stopping may differ from the source.
